description: Use this when a user wants live events ranked by taste, vibe, price, and exclusions. Every result carries recommendation_reasons. Request filters (genres, vibe, event_types, price_max, venue, featuring) are hard filters; avoid and max_price only rank.

avoid.description: Ranking penalties, for example mainstream, huge crowds, expensive tickets, or any word to avoid in titles and tags.

city.description: City name or slug, for example berlin, 'new york', NYC, LA, 'São Paulo'. Required unless query, venue, featuring or promoter is given.

event_types.description: Hard filter. Vocabulary: party, live music, concert, art, museum, comedy, theatre, talk, meetup, food, festival, wellness, sports.

featuring.description: Hard filter on an artist or performer on the lineup.

fields.description: Extra per-event fields: description (long form), coordinates, socials, promoters (full objects). Images and source are always included. Omit for the compact default.

genres.description: Hard filter, for example techno, house, jazz, hip hop, ambient.

limit.description: Same as result_limit; result_limit wins when both are given.

max_price.description: Soft budget used for ranking (over-budget events drop, they are not hidden). Use price_max for a hard cap.

neighborhoods.description: Hard filter on neighborhood names, for example kreuzberg, bushwick.

origin_lat.description: Latitude for sort_by=distance ('near me'). Only pass coordinates the user gave you.

price_max.description: Hard filter: maximum ticket price. Events without a listed price are excluded when set.

profile_id.description: Optional Dizko preference profile id; pass with profile_secret to rank by saved and learned taste as well. rank then defaults to taste.

profile_secret.description: Private profile secret returned when the profile was created.

promoter.description: Hard filter on promoter slug or display name.

query.description: Free-text search, hybrid-ranked by the live API (exact > substring > fuzzy > semantic). Pass soft intent directly, for example 'dark queer warehouse rave' or 'ambient listening bar', or an artist or event name.

result_limit.description: How many ranked events to return (1-50, default 10).

sort_by.description: soonest (chronological), popular (default for multi-day ranges), cost, event_type, or distance (needs origin_lat/origin_lng). Single-day requests default to soonest.

venue.description: Hard filter on venue name (text match), for example Berghain.

vibe.description: Hard filter, for example underground, intimate, high-energy, queer-friendly, outdoors, free-entry.

when.description: Timeframe preset resolved in the city's local timezone: today, tonight, tomorrow, weekend, next weekend, week, next week, month, monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday, any, or an exact date as YYYY-MM-DD. Use date_from/date_to instead for a custom range.
